auteur: Shaofeng Hao, Changyan Liu, Na Li, Yanrong Wu, Dongdong Li, Qingyue Gao, Ziyou Yuan, Guanyan Li, Huilin Li, Jianzhou Yang, and Shengfu Fan.
description: A fundus image showing several signs of diabetic retinopathy: hard exudates (scattered yellowish dots), microaneurysms (bulges off some blood vessels), and small hemorrhages (blurry red dots)
